_comment: P13-05: the third-party scripts served from web/vendor/, audited by vendor_audit.py in CI. An advisory is tolerated only while it is listed under 'accepted' with a reason and a review_by date that has not passed.

accepted.reason: Prototype pollution when PARSING a crafted file. The console only writes workbooks (XLSX.utils, XLSX.writeFile); no page calls XLSX.read/readFile, and tests/test_p13_remediation.py fails the build if one does.
ReDoS when PARSING a crafted file. Unreachable for the same reason: the console never parses spreadsheets.
